title: Wizard Mosiac Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Interesting Coleus
description:
Stunning Foliage for Shady Gardens and Containers!


KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant, multi-coloured foliage with ruby-red, cream, and light green.
• Ideal for brightening up shaded areas in gardens and containers.
• Compact, mounded habit perfect for borders, baskets, and mixed plantings.
• Heat tolerant and late-flowering for extended seasonal appeal.
• Easy to grow and maintain, suitable for all gardening levels.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides 'Wizard Mosaic'
Colour: Light green with ruby-red and creamy white variegation
Season: Late Spring, Summer, Autumn, Late Summer (foliage interest)
Growth Habit: Mounded, Upright


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Partial Shade to Shade
Soil: Well-draining, fertile soil with pH 6.0-7.0
Watering: Medium; keep consistently moist but not waterlogged.
Spacing: 10-14" (25-36cm)
Height: 12-14" (30-36cm)
Spread: 10-12" (25-30cm)
Hardiness: USDA 9-11 (Typically grown as an annual in the UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in well-draining soil, ensuring the root ball is level with the soil surface.
• Maintain consistent moisture, watering regularly at the base of the plant to avoid wetting foliage.
• Fertilise every two weeks during the growing season with a balanced liquid feed.
• Protect from frost; treat as an annual in cooler climates or bring indoors as a houseplant.
• Consider applying mulch to help retain soil moisture and suppress weeds.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
